:::{#thm-bernoulli-mle}
#### Maximum likelihood estimate of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$ and the observed sample mean satisfies $0 < \outbar < 1$,
then the Hessian $\hess(\prob)$ is negative definite for every $\prob \in (0, 1)$,
and the [maximum likelihood estimate](#def-mle) of $\prob$ is the sample mean:

$$\hprob_{\text{ML}} = \outbar$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-nd, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-nd.
It builds on @thm-bernoulli-score-equation and @thm-bernoulli-hessian-sum.

:::
